declarations.doc:
The self-motion ROW of `M̂` vanishes off the diagonal. Immediate from the column reading
and the sealed `mhat_symm`.
declarations.name: Ctrllib.mhat_entry_row_zero
declarations.signature:
Ctrllib.mhat_entry_row_zero.{u_1, u_2} {n : Type u_1} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] {R : Type u_2}
  [CommRing R] {M G P : Matrix n n R} {khat : n → R} {denom : R} {j : n} (hMsymm : M.transpose = M)
  (hGP : G * P = 1) (hkhat : khat = P.mulVec (Pi.single j 1))
  (hrow : denom • G.transpose.mulVec (Pi.single j 1) = M.mulVec khat) (b : n) :
  b ≠ j → (P.transpose * M * P) j b = 0

declarations.signature:

      0 ≤ t✝ → Ctrllib.pointMassEnergy m k ((Ctrllib.pointMassFlow m d k hm).toFun t✝ z) ≤ R
